# cycle_container (Data Source)

Looks up a Cycle container by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a container by ID.
data "cycle_container" "web" {
  id = "651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21"
}

output "container_state" {
  value = data.cycle_container.web.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the container.

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Map of String) Custom metadata for the container.
- `config` (String) The container configuration as normalized JSON.
- `deployment` (String) The deployment descriptor as normalized JSON, or null when unset.
- `deprecate` (Boolean) Whether the container is marked as deprecated.
- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment this container is deployed into.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this container belongs to.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slugged identifier of the container.
- `image_id` (String) The ID of the image used to create this container.
- `instances` (Number) The number of instances for this container.
- `lock` (Boolean) Whether this container is locked against deletion.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the container.
- `state` (String) The current state of the container.
- `stateful` (Boolean) Whether this container is stateful.
